title: Library return slot relocation
brief:
Write a public notice for patrons of Alder Steps Library about a temporary book return location. The usual slot beside the front doors will be unavailable June 3–14 while the doors are repainted. A blue return bin beside the courtyard entrance on Willow Lane will accept books and magazines around the clock. During staffed hours, patrons should bring board games and other boxed items to the desk. The library will keep its usual opening hours. The front slot reopens June 15. Make the location and dates easy to find on a sign posted beside the usual slot.

Aim for 70 to 150 words. Return the complete original work directly in your answer. Do not sign or identify yourself. Do not use tools.

48ebe2f9bc82acb3.text:
# Alder Steps Library  
## Temporary book return · June 3–14

**Return books and magazines to the blue bin beside the courtyard entrance on Willow Lane.** You can use the bin any time, day or night.

The return slot here beside the front doors will be closed June 3–14 while the doors are repainted. For board games and other boxed items, please bring them to the library desk during staffed hours.

The library will keep its usual opening hours. **This slot reopens June 15.**

# Temporary Book Return · June 3–14

## Use the blue bin beside the courtyard entrance on Willow Lane

You can return books and magazines in the blue bin 24 hours a day. The return slot beside the front doors will be closed June 3–14 while the doors are repainted.

Please bring board games and other boxed items to the library desk during staffed hours. Alder Steps Library will keep its usual opening hours.

**The front return slot reopens June 15.**
